title: cutwater configuration
description: The settings of cutwater for one repository, in `.cutwater/config.toml`.

cargo.description:
The Cargo adapter's settings. Its discovery finds the members of the
workspace in the root `Cargo.toml`, or the single crate it declares,
as `cargo metadata` reports them, so cargo must be on the `PATH`.

check.description:
Repository checks: commands that `check`, `goal` or both run after
their own checks. A check receives the units and the plan as JSON on
standard input, runs in the repository root, and fails the step with
a non-zero exit; what it prints appears in the step's output.

default-branch.description: The branch that releases are made from and that merge requests target.

group.description: Fixed groups: units that always share one version and one tag.

npm.description:
The npm adapter's settings. Its discovery finds the packages of a
pnpm workspace (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`), an npm workspace
(`workspaces` in `package.json`) or a single `package.json`, at the
repository root.

release-branch.description:
The branch that holds the release merge request's commit. A merge
request from this branch of the same project is exempt from the
changeset rule of `check`.

release-title.description:
The title of the release merge request, and the first line of its
commit.

unit.description:
Units listed by hand. A listed unit overrides the discovered unit of
the same name; it needs `path` and `adapter` only when no adapter
discovers it.

AdapterKind.description: The ecosystem adapter a unit belongs to.

oneOf.description: npm packages: pnpm and npm workspaces, or a single `package.json`.
Cargo crates: the members of a workspace, or a single crate.

AdapterSettings.description: How an adapter discovers units, and how its units are tagged.

discover.description:
Whether the adapter's publishable packages are units. Private npm
packages and crates with `publish = false` never are.

exclude.description: Names of discovered packages that are not units.

tag.description:
The template of the release tags of the adapter's units that set
none of their own, with the placeholders `{unit}` and `{version}`.
Default: `v{version}` when the repository has one unit,
`{unit}-v{version}` otherwise.

CheckSettings.description: A repository check: a command that a step runs after its own checks.

command.description:
The program and its arguments, run in the repository root without a
shell.

name.description: The check's name, unique among the checks, for the step's output.

steps.description: The steps that run the check.

CheckStep.description: A step that runs repository checks.

oneOf.description: `cutwater goal`, in the release merge request's pipelines.

GitLabSettings.description:
How `mr` and `publish` reach GitLab. The instance and the project are
those of the pipeline, from `CI_SERVER_URL` and `CI_PROJECT_ID`.

merge-queue.description:
Usernames of merge queue accounts. A release merge request assigned
to one of them is queued, and `mr` leaves it as it is.

token-variable.description:
The environment variable that holds the bot's token: a personal
access token of a bot user, or a project access token, with the
`api` scope, whose commits start pipelines. Never `CI_JOB_TOKEN`.

GroupSettings.description: A fixed group: two or more units that always share one version.

tag.description:
The template of the group's release tags, with the placeholders
`{group}` and `{version}`. Default: `v{version}` when the group holds
every unit of the repository, `{group}-v{version}` otherwise.

units.description: The names of the group's units; a unit belongs to at most one group.

registry-timeout.description:
How many seconds `publish` waits, after publishing a version, for its
registry to list it before it counts the version as published and
tags it; it fails when the registry still does not list it then.

UnitSettings.description: A unit: what is versioned and released as one.

adapter.description: The ecosystem adapter that versions and publishes the unit.

assets.description:
Patterns of the release assets, relative to the repository root, in
glob syntax: files that CI builds before `publish`, which uploads
them to the project's generic package registry and links them from
the release. Every pattern must match a file.

name.description:
The unit's name, unique in the repository: for a discovered unit, its
package's name.

path.description: The unit's directory, relative to the repository root.

registry-name.description:
The package name of the unit's release assets in the generic package
registry, of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-` and `+`. Default: the
unit's name with every other character replaced by `-`.

shipped.description:
Patterns of the files the unit ships, relative to its path, in the
syntax of `.gitignore`: a pattern naming a directory covers everything
under it, a pattern starting with `!` excludes, and the last pattern
that applies to a file decides. Without patterns, or with exclusions
only, every file under the path is shipped. Whatever the patterns
say, a unit never ships the files of units nested under it, nor
`.changeset/` or `.cutwater/`.

tag.description:
The template of the unit's release tags, with the placeholders
`{unit}` and `{version}`. Default: the `tag` of the unit's adapter. A
member of a fixed group takes the group's tags and sets none.
